measures.name: M_HoraIni
measures.expression:
VAR FH = MIN(tblConsumosTueste[FechaHoraIni])
VAR Texto = FORMAT(FH, "00000000000000")
VAR HH = MID(Texto, 11, 2)
VAR mi = MID(Texto, 13, 2)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(FH) || FH = 0, "—", HH & ":" & mi)

measures.name: M_HoraFin
measures.expression:
VAR FH = MAX(tblConsumosTueste[FechaHoraFin])
VAR Texto = FORMAT(FH, "00000000000000")
VAR HH = MID(Texto, 11, 2)
VAR mi = MID(Texto, 13, 2)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(FH) || FH = 0, "—", HH & ":" & mi)

measures.name: M_Rendimiento
measures.expression:
VAR CV = SELECTEDVALUE(tblConsumosTueste[PesoCv])
VAR CT = SELECTEDVALUE(tblConsumosTueste[PesoCt])
RETURN
IF(
    CV > 0,
    ROUND((CT / CV) * 100, 2),
    0
)
